fields.summary: No owner answered this plan run. The change set's intent is that a run's final printout and run status show each session's token use and never say 'no token use recorded' for a session that used tokens. Today the printout (internal/api/run.go, the Sessions section) prints that line for any session with no journaled token reading. Readings are journaled only when a session says done, its step ends or it exits, so a live session, or one whose transcript could not be read, shows the line though it has used tokens. Open: whether the printout and run status read the transcript at print time when no reading is journaled. Raised as a question; no owner words are recorded.
fields.title: Run token printout: autonomous plan plus arbiter-raised question
